title: Three Layouts
subtitle: One program builds every gallery layout at once, and the worst quality gauge picks the winner

chapters.title: Three Layouts at Once
chapters.blurb: A Handwired gallery cannot skip work, so it builds Cinema, Contact sheet and Story for twelve photos on every frame.

chapters.title: The Worst Gauge Wins
chapters.blurb: Each layout is scored by its smallest quality gauge, and a tournament of two comparisons lights a single one-hot bit.

chapters.title: Everyone Reads the Winner
chapters.blurb: The one-hot multiplies every layout's geometry and sums, so twelve thumbnails and the hero follow the winner, and clicks follow them.
